name: Agentic Datasets
blurb: A machine-readable contract that lets datasets declare what agents can do, as 15 normative assertions with language-neutral conformance vectors.

name: Agentic Vision
blurb: Selective visual inference with observable decisions, replayed over 1,712 contiguous dashcam frames.

name: Agentic Qubit
blurb: A control plane that refuses quantum results it cannot certify, running entirely in the browser with no backend.

name: Agent Scope
blurb: A control-plane view of agent systems: one node set in ten projections, an operator chat that reads the live cluster, and an admission gate that records every allow and deny, with two recorded demos.

name: Agentic Crawl
blurb: A goal-driven web crawler that checks every request against the site’s rules before sending it and records every choice with its reason, with a live demo of recorded crawls.

name: adam
blurb: AI-written ADaM derivations accepted only on an exact match with the published reference, with every program and verdict re-runnable in the browser on public pharmaverse data.

name: Agentic Loom
blurb: Governed agentic recipes for batch processes: every step admitted before it runs and every exception decided by a person, on the record, with a recorded demo archived on Zenodo.

name: Agentic Delivery
blurb: Governed software delivery: agents propose, and a gate decides each release and each call on evidence it checks itself, with a recorded demo and its measured comparison archived on Zenodo.

name: Agentic LIMS
blurb: Lab data that carries its lineage and decides its own use: public results as an agentic dataset over MCP, a gate per result, a person’s approval, and quotes checked against their page, with a recorded demo archived on Zenodo.

name: System One
blurb: A small model trained under Brain API to judge which admitted capability of a dataset a request is for: 98.1% on generated families it never saw, against 92.6% before training, with its results note and carousel archived on Zenodo.

name: Semantic Field Canvas
blurb: A renderer for fields of nodes and links whose build fails if domain vocabulary appears anywhere in its source.

name: agentic-dataset-conformance
blurb: The contract as executable vectors, with a runner that needs no access to an implementation's internals. Apache-2.0 code, CC0 vectors.

name: authorized-recall
blurb: Retrieval quality measured over the subset a principal is permitted to use. Apache-2.0.

name: @agent-scope-ca/graph-canvas
blurb: The Semantic Field Canvas renderer as a React package. Apache-2.0.
